R0026.title: Prohibited and Illegal Products
R0026.definition: Merchants listing invalid, malicious, or illegal product content.
R0026.description: Merchants list invalid, malicious, or illegal product content to sell non-compliant or illegal goods, or to achieve purposes such as defamation, disruption, traffic diversion, or fraud.
R0026.influence: Disrupts normal system operations, exposes users to fraud risks, and creates compliance risks for the company's normal operations.

references.title: Compliance Guidelines for Prohibited and Restricted Goods Management by Online Trading Platform Operators

observables: Newly listed product titles or main images hit the prohibited-keyword library, or contain external links, WeChat IDs, and other traffic-diversion information
The same merchant bulk-lists many similar high-risk products within a short window, with prices abnormally below market value
The product review section shows a large volume of negative feedback or concentrated complaints mentioning 'traffic diversion' or 'fraud'
Merchant qualifications clearly mismatch the product category (e.g., an individual store listing medical devices or precious metals)
